text: Three independent packages in one Preview source tree: Spacetime 0.1.0a9, EAI 0.8.0-beta, MCCP 0.0.1. Code Apache-2.0.
M0–M10 reference runtime: Observe -> Project -> Govern -> Authorize -> Actuate -> Verify -> Benchmark -> Gate. See /ai/corpus/spacetime.md.
pss temporal-demo --rate 2.5 --quanta 20: CONFIRMED rate 2.5, logical tick 50, matching tick/event-jump state hashes, 47 idle ticks skipped. Owned synthetic runtime; no key.
CPUServiceRate != LogicalTimeRate. Windows Job Object and Linux cgroup v2 resource controls do not virtualize arbitrary process clocks. Native temporal rate belongs to the synthetic runtime.
Observation != Authority; Capability != Authority; PolicyProposal != CommandIntent != Actuation. Native provider targets must be owned or explicitly allowlisted.
Most built-in benchmark workloads are synthetic. Hard Gate 0–6 preserve failures. performance_hypotheses_evaluated=false; B2>B1 and B3>B2 remain open empirical questions.
EAI 0.8: VM-16/64/BASIC, real WASM subset, six CTS roles, JSONL, spreadsheet, rustc optimization flagship, RPN retrofit, six themes, eleven UI tabs. VM-16 has 28 opcodes.
Float VMs, WASM imports/tables/call_indirect/i64/multi-value, formal Hoare proof layer, and general Tier 2/3 retrofit support are not shipped. Equivalence is only as strong as tested-input coverage.

Local Python tracing and bounded graphs with complexity/bug lenses. Basic use needs no key. Optional explanations transmit selected evidence to the configured Anthropic model; raw timeline uses external Perfetto.

Unified source: /download/phosphor-preview-source.zip. Component archives and SHA-256: /download/manifest.json. Read README.md first. Engines retain independent contracts; website control APIs are not hosted.
Existing content-learning terms remain in /ai/rights-spectrum.json. Reading/indexing/RAG/summarization with attribution; commercial training/fine-tuning/distillation require a license.
